t: This is The River House, a building in Kensington and Chelsea. The man connected with it is John Westlake, who died here. Westlake was an English law scholar, a Liberal Member of Parliament and a social reformer. He co-founded the first journal devoted to international law. He was known for his influence on private international law, the field that deals with disputes between people living under different legal jurisdictions. The material I have on the building itself is limited, so that's the story of the place.
